Several photography evening classes, short courses, and local practical groups are `available in and around Coventry`:

### Local Evening Classes & Short Courses

- **Alan Ranger Photography (Beginners Photography Course)** 
	- **Format:** 3-week evening course (consecutive weekly sessions, 7:00 pm – 9:00 pm)
	- **Location:** Tile Hill, Coventry (CV4 9HW) or online via Zoom
	- **Cost:** £150 (small group size capped at 4 participants)
	- **Details:** Covers camera basics, moving off auto mode, exposure, and creative settings. Led by professional photographer Alan Ranger (ABIPP and ARPS qualified). Book via the [Alan Ranger Course Finder](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF198KS8gVQMN3szenxi1Vr2CzAdfS9FWgRL37DIIlnIORuCS5faMhU8nRgiT9mFznfA3nYWyTWknHD3kpbLEJ3A2ZtxkW9S5tojwzJNsaHVcR3oQt7U9QA2TtckB4E_bX98sh-5XWc8ZruPK78LmNH0vAJtY6G_4tlGY4X-s).
	- *Other options by Alan Ranger:* Lightroom photo editing courses and 1-to-1 mentoring.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjQEBxCJF17mqDWWo1cdJCju7nsTDeRRqw51eeBv27yL0L7tkM-vWYqHc6YlOOmQ8vZGG2fdJZFye9JvypMsmH4IfKty4yyRySy3aNHb6OOihAKbR82lcJ-Cw6MEpOVX6QWBu8e-xop6mwlArLhWU-726VmcuEODhLTER0YwBW47MAIRqf8WxHnKsznrpCGI)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF198KS8gVQMN3szenxi1Vr2CzAdfS9FWgRL37DIIlnIORuCS5faMhU8nRgiT9mFznfA3nYWyTWknHD3kpbLEJ3A2ZtxkW9S5tojwzJNsaHVcR3oQt7U9QA2TtckB4E_bX98sh-5XWc8ZruPK78LmNH0vAJtY6G_4tlGY4X-s)
- **Coventry Photography Group** 
	- **Format:** Regular practical walks, evening workshops, and themed sessions (e.g., street photography, light and shadow, holiday lights)
	- **Location:** Various spots around Coventry (such as Canal Basin and city centre)
	- **Cost:** Generally around £32 per session
	- **Details:** Open to all skill levels using either digital cameras or smartphones. Find upcoming schedules on the [Coventry Photography Group](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXTwibH4aehI7Zd-86MuqvHVD9l0gDv0qGjXNiYzkZvYongBZsHAxAIfOzYdZR4sK46SDMQRRb3vrnPMfqn09UQJPRqtYuL3MqOEIDsfs8ukR9msCzoTp_Ub0LM_7-iHU) website.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXTwibH4aehI7Zd-86MuqvHVD9l0gDv0qGjXNiYzkZvYongBZsHAxAIfOzYdZR4sK46SDMQRRb3vrnPMfqn09UQJPRqtYuL3MqOEIDsfs8ukR9msCzoTp_Ub0LM_7-iHU)
- **The Knowledge Academy (Photography Masterclass)** 
	- **Format:** Intensive 1-day structured photography training (can accommodate flexible or late-day scheduling)
	- **Location:** Coventry
	- **Details:** Focuses on camera controls, lighting, composition, and visual storytelling for digital content or hobbyists.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF19gY5n4qzvK6ZP2KS_yxzXNZn-Fe8Y-i4bZmiEaG9Jo3XEelLb0BYgdY6zJ-FCcKHZ5xfbW9fGfSrKosszvYxWuhp_bos7z7a5HZU9LhM_n47f68aeB6RLo8j8T0FqiyN8z8fnnrrpQOOVaNVi5hq9LEXtRQFg4s7HSklBVd525N2k-a5XDMD0vvbl6C9O7DY_iSumHOLT-8HV0P)
- **Coventry College (Level 3 Diploma in Photography / Creative Studies)** 
	- **Format:** Part-time/full-time academic and vocational programs
	- **Location:** Coventry College campus
	- **Details:** Covers film and digital photography, traditional darkroom skills, studio/location lighting, and image manipulation.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF11U9dUMZBCdGaEOCEu3nP1m-r16FnUPg7sqW_TN7aH69QnYtdDKSkaXC5wucyM9sSwZcWv7BJojrgzQcnTSON2u6Iwk_yqgYLGApmz6dcEO2snkErJLBmaxWRdBdQAKslEV2Tf462gmtObRRVu4E-QpodgegnJxbt8QVtrOcUhAcIg)

- Are you a **complete beginner** or looking to build on existing skills?
